_comment: Base images for the Podman integration matrix, pinned by digest.
A tag is not a pin: ubuntu:24.04 is whatever the registry serves that day, and
Ubuntu ships a point release under the same tag without the tag changing. Two runs of
the matrix have to be the same three images, so every entry here is a digest and the
reference a build is given is docker.io/library/ubuntu:VERSION@DIGEST.
resolved_by is the command each digest was actually read with, in this session, so a
reader who doubts one can re-run that one command. A digest with no provenance is a
claim rather than a pin, and the two are indistinguishable by inspection: both match
'sha256:' and both are 64 hex characters. That is the reason the field is here and the
reason 'tests/podman/tests/test_images.py' also asks the registry to serve each digest
again rather than trusting this file.
A version whose image cannot be pulled is recorded with 'unavailable' and a reason, and
never with a plausible-looking digest. There are none: all three pulled.

26.04.release_note: Ubuntu 26.04.1 LTS (Resolute Raccoon). The brief and the plan both said this release might not exist yet; it does. Verified by reading /etc/os-release out of a container of this digest, which reports VERSION_ID=26.04.1.
